review_description: They arrived on time as arranged and completed the installation using top quality panels and brackets to suit our tiled roof.They were very courteous and well mannered tradesmen and I would recommend them to other future solar clients.cheersRichard

A new local company. Their quote was the best I could obtain at the time. They also gave me the phone numbers of two previous clients, who could not speak highly enough of the service, the product and the company. The inverter has a 10 year warranty, all others only had a five year warranty. The system was installed in one day with no fuss or delay. I am very happy, although I haven't received a power bill since installation, looking forward to see how much I have saved.
